opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities.
opportunities.summary: Regular grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no submission deadlines. Grants for operating/core costs typically support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants typically ~10-20% of costs (local community capital projects capped at £30,000).

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations must either have an annual income over £1 million, or total project/capital costs must be over £1 million. For core costs, annual income must be at least £1 million. Must be UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation with at least one year's accounts.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest form all year round (no deadlines), which is reviewed on a rolling basis; shortlisted applicants are invited to submit a full proposal. Supports operating/core costs, capital projects, or project costs.
